name: @mls/briefs
description: Print-ready PDF export for the two presentation briefs. Not part of the root npm workspace: it is documentation tooling, and nothing in apps/ should carry a browser driver in its dependency graph.

scripts.pages: node -e "import('pdf-lib').then(async ({PDFDocument})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');for (const f of ['Meridian-Board-One-Pager.pdf','Meridian-Readiness-Brief.pdf']) {const d=await PDFDocument.load(fs.readFileSync(f));console.log(f+': '+d.getPageCount()+' page(s)')}})"
